limits: Synthetic fixture planner tests are not real GLM quality evidence; no API was called. Reference synthetic verifier pass and candidate unverified are not formal semantic judgments.
This is an opt-in draft controller for two cases; overlay activation, v2 formal grading/full suite and isolated blind-role binding remain separate pending work.
All nodes are isolated logical homes on one physical host and local signed wire; no physical two-node/ICE or process-isolation proof. No remote host was operated in this review.
Native SQLite file/hash/table counts distinguish real engine state from accounting; this is not an exhaustive native persistence/security audit.
Registration ordering is proven by code path and retained fixture timestamps/artifacts, not cryptographically attested immutable external time.
Live owner-source safety and generation handling were reviewed and offline guard tested; a separately authorized real-model run still requires independent outcome/semantics review.
